nodes.name: easy-button.js
nodes.summary: Third-party vendored Leaflet plugin adding easy-to-configure button controls to Leaflet maps.

nodes.name: moment.js
nodes.summary: Shim that imports moment-timezone (10-year data range) and binds it to window.moment so later bundle imports (datetime.js) can depend on it.

nodes.name: posthog.js
nodes.summary: Vendored PostHog JS snippet stub that lazy-loads the analytics array.js and installs a posthog stub on window.

nodes.name: libs.bundle.js
nodes.summary: Aggregator bundle entry importing jquery-bootstrap, moment, Leaflet and its plugins, Sortable and gemoji; exposes SetVueGlobals, Sortable, and gemoji on window.

nodes.name: list.bundle.js
nodes.summary: Aggregator bundle entry for Desk list views: imports base list, list view, filters, indicator, tag/like widgets, and alternate views (gantt, calendar, dashboard, image, map, kanban, inbox, file, tree, interaction).

nodes.name: onboarding_tours.bundle.js
nodes.summary: Tiny bundle entry that imports the onboarding_tours module.

nodes.name: onboarding_tours.js
nodes.summary: Defines frappe.ui.OnboardingTour which wraps driver.js to provide guided product tours with step persistence, offset handling, and navigation between form tours.

nodes.name: photoswipe.bundle.js
nodes.summary: Bundle entry that imports PhotoSwipe and exposes it as frappe.PhotoSwipe.

nodes.name: ConfigureColumns.vue
nodes.summary: Vue 3 SFC (script setup) for the print format builder: lets users drag-reorder table columns, edit labels and widths (percent, total capped at 100), and remove columns.

nodes.name: OnboardingTour
nodes.summary: frappe.ui.OnboardingTour - orchestrates a driver.js-based guided tour: builds steps from a tour record, handles highlighted popover positioning, persistent progress, and dynamic form-tour chaining.

nodes.name: remove_column
nodes.summary: Removes the given column from df.table_columns by reassigning a filtered array.
